notes.title: Dev Diary #2
notes.notes:
Hello!

Thank you for playing "Ed-Zero" Early Access!
Also, thank you for all the feedbacks and requests for the game!

Today, we would like to share some information with you.

[b]-Did you know that "Yabuki Dolls" and "Slicing Tops" were assassination weapons!?[/b]
You already know that the "Assassin Charm" increases your Attack Power when you're unnoticed by enemies. But I believe you may have questions like, it only increases the power of assassination, right? or what good is it against hordes of enemies who are difficult to defeat without being noticed?

In fact, the effect of the "Assassin Charm" also applies to installation-type items such as "Slicing Tops" and "Yabuki Dolls." Therefore, by equipping this charm and throwing and placing items against enemies who are unaware of your presence can also produce tremendous firepower!

So I suggest you to equip multiple "Assassin Charms" and give it a try!

[b]-Unexpected follow-up attack from Raiden's Secret Art "Hyper Shiko"[/b]
The other day, we introduced Raiden's volleyball-like spike jump attack after his Secret Art "Rising Slap" hits. This is due to the slam judgment at the start of Raiden's normal jump attack, but in fact, by adding the "Cancelable" skill to the "Hyper Shiko" which slightly floats the enemy, a {Hyper Shiko →　Cancel → Low Spike} like the quick attack in volleyball can be established!

Other unexpected combo routes may be found depending on the situation and improvisation, such as the "jump-cancel-spike" by picking up a collapsing opponent with a normal attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42119592/f78639449c8528dc59df434607d8245cbbed502f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42119592/81369355920d8c455817b1a5a644dbafaaaf8caa.gif[/img]

[b]-Glimpse of Ninja Production[/b]
Perfect defense (or parry) can be activated by pressing the guard button at the right moment. Instead of a normal parry that repels enemy's attack, Matoka's perfect defense will be a "transformational decoy jutsu" that leaves behind a wooden doll as a substitute and instantly disappears!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42119592/37a1b671a567003f23373ffa6fb50d9dc89b2e8e.jpg[/img]

The Secret Art "Hayabusa Falcon" is a swift action of falsity and truth, which turns the enemy's eyes upward by leaping, and then slashes through the enemy with a blind rush before they even notice.
It's one of the Secret Arts of the ninja, taking advantage of the height.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42119592/a877bb7ebdc8ae8a3ee12fc3bee408d3e7fbe4db.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42119592/9f0bcd9ca856cb926981135c84b0b63ecb363330.jpg[/img]

The "Earth Jutsu," which embeds a magical mark in the ground and uses a blade of rock to pierce the enemy as they step into it. Depending on the amount of time it takes to accumulate, it's possible to set multiple "Earth Jutsu" at the same time, luring hordes of zombies into a trap, defeating them at once, or continuing the thrust in rapid succession!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42119592/cef4c245b957655f2433412e8d42976e98fca8e1.jpg[/img]

Please wait a little longer for her arrival!

Thank you,

Team Ed-Zero

notes.title: 【Exorcism-Poison Build】～Samurai Exclusive～
notes.notes:
Hello,

We would like to introduce the recommended combination of Secret Arts and Charms so that you can enjoy "Ed-0" even more!
(We call the combination of Secret Arts and Charms as "builds")
Try it out yourself!

[b]■Introduction of Secret Arts & Charms Combination Part 3[/b]

[b]【Exorcism-Poison Build】～Samurai Exclusive～[/b]

A Samurai exclusive build that always allow you to fight in a favorable situation while spreading abnormalities such as "Poison!"

----------------------
Secret Arts
　・Hyper Slash x1 (Skills: Cool Time Reduction, Additional Attack Lv3, Attack Power +）
　・Exorcism x1 (Skill: Cancellable）
　・Katana Spirit x2 (Skill: Cancellable）

Charms
　・Taster Charm x1 ※Indispensable
　・Poisoned Charm x1 ※Indispensable
　・Tainted Charm x1 ※Recommended
　・Butcher Charm ×1 ※Recommended	
　・Pursuit Charms x2
----------------------

[b]【Summary】[/b]
One of the negative effects of the “Poisoned Charm” will be turned into an enhancement by the “Taster Charm,” and while following up on hunger with the “Butcher Charm,” the Secret Art "Exorcism" gives poison and the firepower of “Hyper Slash” will be enhanced by the double “Katana Spirits” buff. 
So this Samurai exclusive build will always give an advantageous situation to aim for great damage!

[b]【Details】[/b]
　・Secret Art “Exorcism” can force your Poisoned status on enemies.
　・Secret Art “Katana Spirit” can increase your Attack Power, and by setting two of them, you can aim for a stacked effect increase.
　・Strengthen the Secret Art “Hyper Slash” in a way that directly affects its firepower.
　・Equip “Taster Charm” and you can counteract one of the negative effects of being Poisoned, namely the reduction of Attack Power.
　・Equip “Poisoned Charm” and your Poisoned status will not be cured at any time.
　・Equip “Butcher Charm” and it would aid against the other negative effect of being Poisoned, namely the Fullness reduction.
　・Equip “Pursuit Charm” and bullets will be generated when an enemy is defeated which will attack the next target.

We have uploaded a video below that explains the "Exorcism-Poison" build in detail.
If you want to see it in the actual gameplay, check out this video!

[previewyoutube=RQb1TVzJKa4;full][/previewyoutube]

Team Ed-Zero

notes.title: Dev Diary
notes.notes:
Hello!

Thank you for playing "Ed-Zero" Early Access!
Also, thank you for all the feedbacks and requests for the game!

Today, we would like to tell you a little bit about the game.

[b]●Build (combination of Secret Arts & Charms)[/b]
We've received some comments about the "DO-GE-ZA-blaze Build" which we recently introduced in the video, saying that it is not so easy to create that build because of the rarity of the Secret Arts and Charms.

We will introduce some different builds in the near future, but there are many builds you can build in this game, just like "hands"in a card game.

For example, in the "DO-GE-ZA-blaze" build, the Secret Art "DO-GE-ZA" can be substituted for any other Secret Arts by just adding the "Cancelable" skill enhancement to a set of three other offensive Secret Arts.

You may also combine it with the "Blessings of the Sacred Tree," equip multiple "Fleet-Foot Charms" for a "Hyper Speed Build," equip multiple "Divine Charms" for a "Build with Unlimited Secret Arts," equip multiple "Critical Charms" for a "Critical Build," and much more!

We strongly think that the idea of changing your strengthening plan along the way, depending on how many Charms you collect and how well you strengthen your Secret Arts, is one of the best parts of rogue-like games!

Try it out and see for yourself!

[b]●Upcoming Update[/b]
In the minor update to be delivered soon, we plan to add a "smack" effect to the start of Raiden's jump normal attack.
It goes perfectly well with the Secret Art "Rising Slap," so learn when to launch it and give it a try!
You can knock zombies out in mid-air just like a volleyball spike!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42119592/ea3bf4dad282d25852d4b96e016b16fb7bd88748.jpg[/img]

In addition, we plan to add the prevention of drunkenness to the effect of the "Drunkard Charm."
This Charm will still cause vomiting when intoxicated, but will not render you inoperable, so try making an "Drunken Build" and play with it in combination with the "Heavy Drinker Charm!"

[b]●Glimpse of Ninja Production[/b]
Lastly, we would like to show you a few Secret Arts under development for the Ninja that will be playable in early summer!
These Secret Arts are called "Fuu Jin" and "Rai Jin," and as you can see, these seem to have special effects!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42119592/03130a3ab3f8730dbc174961cc50ec69e7ab5406.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42119592/a853d3d6930c4b90e586062999104411e0607a66.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42119592/20256f535c45f4e8c24b2a6d52e5ec6c4b72aa98.png[/img]

You will surely be able to enjoy a different kind of Ninja action totally different from the techinque type Samurai and the power type Sumo Wrestler!
Please wait a little longer!

Thank you for reading!

Team Ed-Zero

notes.title: Introducing the "DO-GE-ZA-blaze" build for more exhilarating gameplay!
notes.notes:
Hello,

We would like to introduce the recommended combination of Secret Arts and Charms so that you can enjoy "Ed-0" even more!
(We call the combination of Secret Arts and Charms as "builds")
Try it out yourself!

■Introduction of Secret Arts & Charms Combination Part 1

[b]【DO-GE-ZA-blaze Build】～Samurai Generic～[/b]

After activating "Katana Spirit" to boost firepower, cancel "DO-GE-ZA" in rapid succession to decimate a group of enemies in one fell swoop!

----------------------
Secret Arts
　・DO-GE-ZA x3 (Skills: Cancellable, Additional Attack）
　・Katana Spirit x1 (Skill: Cancellable）

Charms
　・Blazing Charms x2		
　・Critical Charms x2
　・Instant Karma Charms x3
　・Pursuit Charms x2
----------------------

【Summary】
Even though the Secret Art “DO-GE-ZA” does not have so much firepower itself, you can increase it by simply equipping charms that will boost the basic Attack Power and using the Secret Art “Katana Spirit.”
Also, you may burn enemies by equipping the "Blazing Charm." 
You can smoothly cancel one skill to another by performing “Katana Spirit” →　Cancel → “DO-GE-ZA” → Cancel → “DO-GE-ZA” → Cancel → “DO-GE-ZA.” 
This will allow triple high powered “DO-GE-ZA” in a row + burning the enemies without being disturbed.

【Details】
　・Secret Art “DO-GE-ZA” has a long invisible time and by strengthening it with cancellable, you can use the invisible time wisely and keep on attacking without any disturbance.
　・Secret Art “Katana Spirit” can increase your Attack Power, and by strengthening it with cancellable, you can smoothly go on to the next skill you want to perform.
　・Equip “Blazing Charm” so you can burn all the enemies you are going to apologize to.
　・Equip “Critical Charm” so you can simply increase the skill firepower.
　・Equip “Pursuit Charm” and “Instant Karma Charm” so that bullets will be generated in certain situations.

We have uploaded a video below that explains the "DO-GE-ZA-blaze" build in detail.
